base_mechanics.class_restriction: Only Mage can equip as melee weapon

types.name: WandOfMagicMissile
types.special: DISENCHANT: consumes self to upgrade another wand +1 and grant ScrollOfUpgrade effect. Costs 2 turns

types.name: WandOfFirebolt
types.effect: Applies Burning, seeds Fire along path on flammable tiles

types.name: WandOfLightning
types.effect: Chains to adjacent un-hit targets, each bounce halves min damage. 2x damage in water

types.name: WandOfDisintegration
types.damage: Random.NormalIntRange(lvl, 8 + lvl^2/3) where lvl = power + numTargets
types.effect: Piercing beam hits ALL characters in path. More targets = more damage each. Destroys doors/signs, converts high grass

types.name: WandOfAvalanche
types.damage: Random.Int(2, 6 + (size-d)*2) where size = 1+level/3, d = distance from center
types.effect: AoE. Paralysis chance decreases with distance (2-6 turns). Camera shake

types.name: WandOfPoison
types.effect: Applies Poison for durationFactor * (5 + power) turns

types.name: WandOfAmok
types.effect: On enemy: Amok for 3+power turns (forced attacking). On self: Vertigo

types.name: WandOfSlowness
types.effect: Slow for Slow.duration/3 + power turns

types.name: WandOfBlink
types.effect: Teleports self up to level+4 cells in a line

types.name: WandOfTeleportation
types.effect: On self: random teleport. On enemy: teleports to random respawn cell (10 attempts)

types.name: WandOfFlock
types.effect: Summons level+2 invulnerable sheep for level+3 turns

types.name: WandOfReach
types.effect: Range power+4 cells. On creature: swap positions. On item heap: grab item. On chest/tomb: open remotely

types.name: WandOfRegrowth
types.effect: Converts empty tiles to grass along path. Seeds Regrowth blob amount = (power+2)*20

base_mechanics.freeze_converts_to: varies (e.g., Liquid Flame -> Frost Potion area)

types.name: PotionOfHealing
types.effect: Restores all HP. Cures Poison, Cripple, Weakness, Bleeding

types.name: PotionOfStrength
types.effect: Permanently increases STR by 1

types.name: PotionOfMight
types.effect: Permanently increases STR by 1 and max HP by 5

types.name: PotionOfExperience
types.effect: Grants hero enough EXP for next level up

types.name: PotionOfMindVision
types.effect: Reveals all mobs on the level for MindVision.DURATION turns

types.name: PotionOfInvisibility
types.effect: Grants Invisibility for Invisibility.DURATION turns

types.name: PotionOfLevitation
types.effect: Grants Levitation for Levitation.DURATION turns. Reveals traps when floating

types.name: PotionOfFrost
types.effect: Freezes all adjacent creatures (3x3 area). Applies Frost debuff. Extinguishes fire

types.name: PotionOfLiquidFlame
types.effect: Sets 3x3 area on fire. Applies Burning to creatures in range

types.name: PotionOfToxicGas
types.effect: Creates ToxicGas cloud (volume 1000) at location

types.name: PotionOfParalyticGas
types.effect: Creates ParalyticGas cloud (volume 1000) at location

types.name: PotionOfPurity
types.effect: Removes gas blobs in 5-tile radius. Cures Paralysis and makes immune to gas briefly

types.name: ScrollOfIdentify
types.effect: Identifies one item in inventory

types.name: ScrollOfUpgrade
types.effect: Upgrades one item by +1. Repairs item to max durability. May remove curse

types.name: ScrollOfEnchantment
types.effect: Applies random enchantment to weapon or glyph to armor

types.name: ScrollOfRemoveCurse
types.effect: Removes curses from all equipped and carried items

types.name: ScrollOfMagicMapping
types.effect: Reveals entire level map including hidden rooms and traps

types.name: ScrollOfTeleportation
types.effect: Teleports hero to random location on current level

types.name: ScrollOfRecharging
types.effect: Fully recharges all equipped wands

types.name: ScrollOfMirrorImage
types.effect: Creates NImages.NIMAGES mirror images of the hero

types.name: ScrollOfLullaby
types.effect: Puts all visible enemies to Sleep

types.name: ScrollOfTerror
types.effect: Applies Terror to all visible enemies, making them flee

types.name: ScrollOfChallenge
types.effect: Alerts and enrages all enemies on the level (like reading a scroll near enemies)

types.name: ScrollOfPsionicBlast
types.effect: Deals massive damage to all visible enemies. Also damages and blinds the hero

types.name: ScrollOfWipeOut
types.effect: Kills all visible enemies instantly

hunger_system.mage_bonus: Eating recharges 1 charge on all wands

types.name: Pasty
types.notes: Full hunger restoration to STARVING threshold

types.name: MysteryMeat
types.notes: 20% each: Burning, Roots, Poison(HT/5), Slow; 20% nothing

types.name: ChargrilledMeat
types.notes: Cooked MysteryMeat via fire. Safe to eat

types.name: FrozenCarpaccio
types.notes: Frozen MysteryMeat. 20% each: Invisibility, Barkskin(HT/4), cure debuffs, heal HT/4; 20% nothing

types.name: RingOfAccuracy
types.effect: Multiplies attack accuracy

types.name: RingOfEvasion
types.effect: Multiplies defense/evasion skill

types.name: RingOfHaste
types.effect: Reduces time spent on all actions

types.name: RingOfElements
types.effect: Chance to resist elemental damage; reduces debuff durations

types.name: RingOfDetection
types.effect: Increases search range for traps and secret doors

types.name: RingOfShadows
types.effect: Increases stealth, making hero harder to detect
types.notes: Rogue starts with +1 Ring of Shadows (pre-identified)

types.name: RingOfPower
types.effect: Directly additive to wand power level

types.name: RingOfHerbalism
types.effect: Increases seed/dew drop from trampling grass. Cursed: no drops at all

types.name: RingOfSatiety
types.effect: Reduces hunger rate. At +10: hunger never increases

types.name: RingOfMending
types.effect: Increases natural HP regeneration rate (1 HP per delay ticks)

types.name: RingOfThorns
types.formula: reflects Random.IntRange(0, damage) back to attacker
types.effect: Binary effect: reflects 0-100% of melee damage. Not upgradable

types.name: RingOfHaggler
types.effect: Binary effect: halves shop prices. Not upgradable

special_items.name: Amulet of Yendor
special_items.description: Final goal item on floor 26. Obtaining it wins the game

special_items.name: Ankh
special_items.description: Resurrects hero on death. Uses tracked in Statistics.ankhsUsed

special_items.name: DewVial
special_items.description: Collects dewdrops. One per run. Can store and use dew for healing

special_items.name: Honeypot
special_items.description: Contains a Bee ally. Breaks on throw to release bee

special_items.name: TomeOfMastery
special_items.description: Allows hero to choose subclass. Dropped by Tengu (floor 10 boss)

special_items.name: Torch
special_items.description: Provides Light buff, extending view distance

special_items.name: Weightstone
special_items.description: Imbues weapon with SPEED or ACCURACY

keys.name: IronKey
keys.description: Opens locked doors on the same floor

keys.name: SkeletonKey
keys.description: Opens locked doors across any floor
